desc: The Aimpoint ACRO P2 is rapidly becoming the ‘go-to’ red dot optic for professional working pistols. The rugged closed-emitter design and aerospace grade aluminum case has proven to take a beating that sidelines competitors. That said, the front lens is front and center for taking potential damaging impact. The good news is, it is easily replaced at minimal charge. The bad news, it has to go back to the factory for that service. Avoid the hassle and protect your expensive red dot with our P2 Lens Guard. Precision CNC machined aerospace grade aluminum frame, with Type III hard coat anodize, easily attaches in seconds to your P2 with provided stainless-steel set screws and wrench. The Lens Guard also makes a great ‘slide racker’, without leaving hand prints on your P2 front lens.
